'''Jmmaar''' was a [[Viraanntesse]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vvaw/Legends|Vvaw]]. Prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Jmmaar and fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master [[T'chooka D'oon]] were sent to the planet [[Kalee/Legends|Kalee]] to resolve the [[Huk War]]&mdash;fought between Kalee's native [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] and the invading [[Yam'rii/Legends|Huk]] [[Species/Legends|species]]&mdash;and supported the Huk, a decision that placed the Kaleesh in a state of destitution. One of the Kaleesh [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]] who witnessed the Jedi's decision to not help them was [[Grievous/Legends|Qymaen jai Sheelal]], who, during the Clone Wars, was known as the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[General/Legends|General]] Grievous. In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], on the planet [[Vandos]], Jmmaar and D'oon were [[Death/Legends|slain]] by the cyborg general when they arrived on Vandos to [[Rescue mission to Vandos|rescue]] [[Anx/Legends|Anx]] [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] [[Quiyyen]] from Grievous.

==Biography==
[[File:Grievous-ROTSICS.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Grievous with Jmmaar's lightsaber]]
Jmmaar, a [[Limb/Legends|ten-legged]]<ref name="rotsics">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> [[Viraanntesse]] was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vvaw/Legends|Vvaw]]. Sometime before the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Jmmaar and fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master [[T'chooka D'oon]] were sent to the planet [[Kalee/Legends|Kalee]] to put an end to the [[Huk War]], a conflict that began after the [[Yam'rii/Legends|Huk]] [[Species/Legends|species]] invaded Kalee to [[Slavery/Legends|enslave]] the native [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]].<ref name="cswe" /> Through the persuasion of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]],<ref name="story">{{InsiderCite|86|Unknown Soldier: The Story of General Grievous}}</ref> both Jmmaar and D'oon decided to aid and pledge support for the Huks, which drove the Kaleesh into a state of depression and starvation. As a result of their decision, both Jmmaar and D'oon were disliked in the [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] of the Kaleesh. One of the Kaleesh [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]] to witness Jmmaar and D'oon's decision to not help Kalee's inhabitants was [[Grievous/Legends|Qymaen jai Sheelal]]. Sheelal, who would later be known as the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[General/Legends|General]] Grievous during the Clone Wars, never forgot the two Jedi Masters.<ref name="cswe" />

In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="nec" /> Jmmaar,<ref name="cswe" /> D'oon, and D'oon's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Flynn Kybo]], were dispatched to the planet [[Vandos]] to [[Rescue mission to Vandos|rescue]] Republic [[Anx/Legends|Anx]] [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] [[Quiyyen]], who had been kidnapped by Grievous.<ref name="gg1">[[General Grievous 1|''General Grievous'' 1]]</ref> During their mission, both Jmmaar<ref name="cswe" /> and D'oon were [[Death/Legends|slain]] by the cyborg general, though D'oon's Padawan found and rescued the captive Quiyyen.<ref name="gg1" /> As a trophy, Grievous took the fallen Jmmaar's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]<ref name="rotsics" /> and considered it to be one of his favorite weapons. Grievous later utilized Jmmaar's<ref name="rotsn">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref> [[Color/Legends|green-bladed]]<ref name="rotsics" /> weapon during a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|fight]] with Jedi Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] on the planet [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]] in the final [[19 BBY/Legends|year]] of the Clone Wars.<ref name="rotsn" />

==Personality and traits==
Due to his decision to support the Huk, Jmmaar was disliked by the Kaleesh. The Jedi Master's decision eventually led to his death on Vandos, where Jmmaar was killed by Grievous, a former Kaleesh warlord that remembered Jmmaar's actions on Kalee.<ref name="cswe" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jmmaar was first mentioned in author [[Matthew Stover]]'s [[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|novelization of ''Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith'']], and in ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]'', written by [[Curtis Saxton]]. The Jedi Master received a brief mention in the short story ''[[Unknown Soldier: The Story of General Grievous]]'', written by author [[Abel G. Peña]], and was later given a short entry in the [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.
